title: Elfstein Simple Pack
description: Near Vanilla Modpack with QOL and performance improvements.Developed for Elfstein Servers
body:
A lightweight, modern Minecraft client modpack focused on performance, visuals, and quality-of-life improvements — Mainly targeted for the Players of Elfstein-Servers. This pack enhances your game with optimized rendering, shader support, and useful UI upgrades while staying close to Minecraft’s original gameplay.

### ----Key Features---- Performance optimizations with FerriteCore, More Culling, and Voxy for better FPS and lower memory usage (including support for voxy server side) Full shader support via Iris, including multiple shader options from high-end visuals to lightweight presets Improved visuals with Out-of-the-Box resource packs Better UI and gameplay feedback with AppleSkin, WTHIT, Light Overlay and JourneyMap Built-in voice chat with Simple Voice Chat for multiplayer sessions(Server support needed) Quality-of-life tweaks like zoom, chat improvements, and cleaner settings menus

### ----Visual Experience---- Choose your preferred style depending on your hardware: High quality: Complementary Shaders / Rethinking Voxels Balanced: Mellow shaders Low-end friendly: Potato Shaders

### --Notes-- This modpack does not add new gameplay mechanics, items, or progression systems. Instead, it refines and enhances the vanilla experience with modern tools and visual upgrades. Fully client-side compatible (most mods optional on servers) Works best in multiplayer environments
Designed for stability and smooth gameplay
Needed on Server for full functionality support:
[Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/project/9eGKb6K1)
[Jurneymap](https://modrinth.com/project/lfHFW1mp)
[WTHIT](https://modrinth.com/project/6AQIaxuO)
[AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/project/EsAfCjCV)
[Voxy Server Side](https://modrinth.com/project/84zcagOb)
